command: the side command of demos/bench/run.ts, once per side, 3 rounds over tree4:10000,chain:10000,tree4:50000,chain:50000 with ours and DHTMLX interleaved, --dnf-s 120, --memory-at-s 20, quiet cap load1 under 4
driverOptions: the driver's defaults, the same for both sides (--dnf-s 120, --memory-at-s 20)
method: One generator run gives every side the same tasks, links and dates, and each side loads its own file of that data in its own shape (DHTMLX its own file; ours the ours.json that it hands to mount(el, { tasks, links }) on demos/bench/sides/ours-page.html). Memory is the browser total 20 s after the navigation, the page idle. The comparison is load and draw: DHTMLX community cannot schedule, and ours solves the schedule on open. Ours is the published release 0.4.0 (build 7ecb106). The DHTMLX side is driven by the harness of a later commit; the load, scroll and memory phases are the same in both.
assembled: The two sides ran on different harness commits, so this results file was assembled from the per-run files in demos/bench/results/2026-11-22/ instead of being written by results-file.ts.
tree: The runs are the directories in 2026-11-22/ beside this file: <cell>/<run>/<side>/{result.json,side.json,load.log,wait.log}; the medians below are of the 3 runs of each side in each cell. dataset.json is not kept: node demos/bench/dataset.ts --shape <shape> --size <n> --seed 20261020 --out <dir> rebuilds it byte for byte, and its SHA-256 is in each cell above.

chain-10000.note: 3 runs of each side, interleaved in one session; every run counts, with no load-matching filter

chain-50000.note: 3 runs of each side, interleaved in one session; every run counts, with no load-matching filter

tree4-10000.note: 3 runs of each side, interleaved in one session; every run counts, with no load-matching filter

tree4-50000.note: 3 runs of each side, interleaved in one session; every run counts, with no load-matching filter

box.quietCap: load1 under 4 before each run (--max-load 4, not raised)
box.wallClock: 2026-11-22 00:32 to 01:30 MST, 3 runs per cell and side; two users were logged in
